translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nzycmne-ebzpxngr Nzmungr Kxetu Heven
Zbz Jiszs yapwxti-mopwzle kc nzycmne-ebzpxngr mz leplz kcng tzyrlwrng Mangr-nzangiongr.
Rpibzle badr kx, “Napibo bamu kxmu nzvectr-krm Gct leplz bade mz be lc. Kzdq kc king oliqtile kc nzmungr kxetu mz nzyrlzkr mrlxde.
Atwzlr-ngrbzle kxnzawz nedeng kx napibzlr mz kxnzaveating kx navzpemqng. A' nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzvz-krmlr.
Mz nibrde atwzlr-mou-ngrbzle kxnzawz nedeng mz kxnzaveating mz nzrpi-krbzlr badr kx, ‘Mzli ka da amrlx mrlzpe. Murde kzu nznibqtipe x nzbipeng. Vzpemamu mz nzmungr mzli ka!’
“Kxmule-esz', a' leplz kcng trnzlxngitilru nrpa kc. X matitr drtwrdr zbq lc x nzvz-bekang mz nepu nr drtwrdr. Kzdung nzvzng mz nrlanc nyzdr. X kzdung nzvzng mz nzwzngr.
X kzdung nzlolvzlr kxnzawz neng king, nztzlr nidr, vz x nzbzng.
King kc drtwrde ngyatx zlwz. X atwzlr-ngrde ami nede x nznibqtilr leplz kcng tznibqtilr kxnzawz nedeng x nzkatrpzlr nyr ngr mztea nyzdr.
“Zbz kqlele kxnzawz nedeng x rpibzle badr kx, ‘Nzmungr oliqtxpe.’ A' leplz kcng tqaveatixng trnztakitrdru nidr nzprtr-krdr mz nzmungr lc.
Vznamu mz lrpzki amrlx x rvzmimamu leplz amrlx kx rmctiamu, navzmqng mz nzmungr lc.
Kxnzawz nedeng nzvzng mz lrpzki x nzayrlwr-lxblrlr leplz amrlx kcng tzrmctilr, kxmule-esz' kxnzmrlzng o kxnztrkang. X ma nyz King yrbupxm mz leplz.
“A' mzli kc king tqvzpe-ngrmle mz nzmc-krde leplz amrlx, rmctile kc ncblo kx trpxi-ngrdeu lrpz kx kabzle mz leplz lcng amrlx, mz nztakitr-krde nidr nzprtr-krdr mz nzmungr lc.
Rpibz king bade kx, ‘?Mzlenge, memule tqvztr-ngrme mrka, trpxiwq lrpz kxmyapxbz kc tqkabo?’ A' ncblo kc anabu txpwz.
Rpibz king mz kxnzawz nedeng kx, ‘Peamu mrlx lc x rtcpx-ngrnamu yz, mrkc tqtungr nzlo x tzyrningr leplz mz nzetqkr drtqdr x tzmadqti-ngrdr nqngidr mz zngya.’”
Zbz Jiszs ayrkrpxle nzycmne-ebzpxngr lc mz nzrpi-krbzle kx, “Kxmule-esz' Gct aveatile leplz kxnzkqlung mz nzmnclz-krbzlr bade mz nzngini-krde king, a' kxnzmcpxng nzpipzng.”
Nzrveatingr Nzxpengr Takes
Zbz Farzsi nzvzng x sc tzyrlwr-lxblrpeng mz nzryrlq-krdr drtwr ngr nzrtxtio-krdr Jiszs br mz nzycmne-krde, murde nalolvzlr nide.

Nzatwzlr-ngrbzlr bade kcng oblamzng Farzsi x kzdung leplz ngr dzbede kc mz Herot. Nzvzbzng nzrpibzlr kx, “Kxakrlz, krlzkr kx nike piq x alvztr-ngrn tubq zvz. X krlz-kzkr kx tu-amqngi-zvzq mz nzalvztr-krbzme nqmq kr Gct mz leplz, kxmule-esz' trna-abrtzlvzu kxnzetung.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, pim ena bagr nike pnz drtwrm. ?Tubq mz Lou sc Mosis nzxpe-krbzku takes mz King r Rom o trtingr?”

A' mcplxtrpebz Jiszs nzatalz-krdr. Murde mz nzrpi-krbzle Eu, lr Jiu lcng nangyati drtwrdr nide mz nzokatr-krde enqmi rdr. X mz nzrpi-krbzle Trtingr, ncblo neng King Herot nalolvzlr nide mz nzxpqbrlr-krde lou sc gzpman ngr Rom. Rpibzle badr kx, “Nimu blzpokiang! ?Memule tqrpi-ngrnamu na-atalz-ngrnamu ninge?
Aelwa-ngrmamu dq ena srlrni kc tqxpe-ngrnamu takes.” Nzaelwa-ngrbzlr kc srlrni.
X sc tqveapebz kx, “?Mqngr nar nelc tqmnztr mz srlrni lc, x drtq nelc tzyrtr elr?”
Nzrpibzlr kx, “King r Rom.” Zbz rpibzle badr kx, “Mz nzmu-krde lcde, kabzmu mz king da kx takitrde king x kabzmu mz Gct da kx takitrde Gct.”
Ncblo kcng kx nzxlrbzlr da lc nzkctitxpxlr natqde, murde trprtz-pnzu mz trtxki scdr. X sc tzdwaszpelr nide.
Nzrveatingr Nztulz-ngrm Mz Nzbzngr

Mz zbq lcpwz, kzdung Sadiusi nzvzmqng mz Jiszs Mangr-nzangiongr. Nidr dzbe lr Jiu kx trnzlxngitilru nztulz-mou-ngrm mz nzbzngr. Nzveatibzlr da kx na-atrkati-ngrbzlr nzalvztr-krde mz nzlu-mou-ngrm mz nzbzngr.

Nzrpibzlr kx, “Kxakrlz, rpi Mosis kx, ‘Nzmu ncblo kx bzszle olvz rde x trpnzngr nedr doa, mzlede nayrlzti-alzule olvz lc, murde nzrngine-krdr doa na-apule kx ngi doa ne mzlede kc tqbzpe. X doa lc natekqtrle nzmrbrpx-krbz nqvi lr ncblo kc tqbz x natwzle dztudeng.’
Nzmu narpingr kx kzdung mzle-lzbq nzrlimzng. Mzledr kc tqetu yrlz. Zbz mzli trboiu sc tqbzszpele olvz rde, trpnzngr nedr doa. X olvz rde natwz alzu mzlede krali.
Da lc nzwai mzlede krali x kratq. Vz, vz, olvz kc nzyrlzti mzle-lzbq kcng nzrlimz.
A' trpnzngr nedr doa. X mz nibrde olvz kc sc tqbzpe kz.

Alvztr-ngrn kx leplz tulz-mop mz nzbzngr. ?Kx tqmule lcde, neke nartwz olvz kc mzli kc natulz-moungr leplz amrlx? Murde mzle-lzbq kcng rlimz nzyrlztilr nide. ?Myx kxmule, Gct batrpzle mz olvz lc nzxpqbrlr-krde natqde mz nzyrlzti-krde ncblo kcng rlimz mz mzli kxesz'?”
Jiszs ayzlu-ngrbzle natqdr kx, “Nzao-krmu drtwrmu vz-rbrtx atwrnrngr. Murde tryrplatitru narmu zmatq ngr Gct x drtwr ngr Nzryrngrkxtr.
Mzli kc na-alu-moungr Gct leplz mz nzbzngr, sa na-apupelr enjrl kcng tzmncng Heven. Trnzyrlzpeung, x trpnzngr nzyrlz-mou-krdr kalr.
X Gct aelwapx-ngrde kx krkcng tzbzpeng sa na-atulzmqng mz nzlungr. Krlz-angidramu natq Gct kc tqrpibzle bamu kx,
‘Ninge Gct ngr Ebraam, Aesak x Jekop.’ Kxmule-esz' ncblo lcng tq nzbz-pnzng, a' trpileu kx nide Gct ngrdr mzli kc pnz. Murde nibede Gct ngrdr mz nzlu-krdr Heven mzli ka.”
Kx nzxlrbz zbo ngr leplz natq lc, nzkctitxpxlr nzalvztr-krde.
Lou Kxmyapxbz
Kx nzxlr dzbe Farzsi nzamyati-krbz Jiszs drtq dzbe Sadiusi x awx-nabule nidr, sc tzyrlwr-lxblrpeng mz nzryrlq-krdr drtwr ngr nzatalz-krdr nide.
Zbz kzdq nidr kc tqngi kz kxalvztr mz lou sc Mosis, vzbz bade x sc tqveapebz bade kx,
“?Kxakrlz, lou kznike myaszpxle lou amrlx?”
Ayzlu-ngrbz Jiszs natqde kx, “Doa kxesz' mz nimu, namrlztiq Yawe, Gct rmu mz nabzm atwrnrngr, x mz nzwikr nelzm atwrnrngr, x mz drtwrm atwrnrngr.
Krlc lou sc Gct kx ayrnrngr x kx myapxbz.
X lou krali apupwzle nide. Rpile kx, ‘Esz' mz nimu, namrlztiq kztemqng da kc tqwaiq nzmrlzti-lzbq-krm.’
Lou lcng li ngi nou da amrlx mz Lou sc Mosis x nzalvztrkr profet.”
Nzrveatingr Kxnzmcpx Ne Gct
Mzli kc tzyrlwrbengr Farzsi kcng mrkc, Jiszs rveabz badr kx,
“?Mz drtwrmu neke tqngi Kxnzmcpx, x vzpxm mz nqvi lr ncblo kznike?” Nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Vzpxm mz nqvi lr King Devet.”
Zbz Jiszs rvea-mopwz badr kx, “A' memule tqbatr-ngrbz Mqngrkxtr mz Devet nzrpi-krde kx Kxnzmcpx nide kxetu rde. Murde rpi Devet kx,
‘Yawe rpibzle mz King kc tqngi kxetu rnge kx, Wxbu mrlc tqmatq-esz'ngr mz nrlarnge kxrtc, navz nakrlz-zpwxbzle mzli kc nangi-batr-ngrbo mz enqmi rmqng nzmetx-krbzlr bam.’
Mz Sam lc Devet rpile kx, Kxnzmcpx ngi kxetu rde. ?A' myx kxnamu Kxnzmcpx nznginikr doa mz nqvi lrde kc mzte trnzmcka, x mzli kcpwz ngi kz kxetu rde?”
A' nzveakr Jiszs trpnzngr kx ayzlubz. X abzo mz zbq lc, trpnz-moungr kx veabz bade da, murde ma drtqdr tqmya zvz.

footnotes.text: Lrpz kxmyapxbz kc tqkabz King drtwr ngrde leplz kxnztubqng mz nzobqkr Gct mz nzlxngiti-krdr Jiszs.
Jiszs na-aelwapx-ngrbzle badr kx Kxnzmcpx trngi-txpwzu ncblo, a' myaszlzle ncblo murde Gct amyalzle nide. A' trpnzngr nidr kx yrplatitr narde natqde.
